name: Gab Smolders
note: Calm, methodical full playthroughs. Horror and cozy in equal measure.

name: The Sphere Hunter
note: Survival horror and action-RPG deep dives, especially Resident Evil and Final Fantasy.

name: Laura Kate Dale
note: Indie coverage and the most rigorous accessibility reviews anywhere.

name: Alanah Pearce
note: Critic and working AAA developer, so the industry commentary comes from inside.

name: Stephanie Sterling
note: Consumer advocacy and unsparing AAA critique. Independent since 2014.

name: Skurry
note: Metroidvanias and puzzle games, with a lot of Hollow Knight.

name: WhatAboutAndy
note: Cozy games and long comfortable sessions.

name: FunkyFrogBait
note: Horror games played for comedy, and video essays that sneak up on you.

name: Dead Domain
note: Variety gaming and commentary, heavy on the strange and overlooked.

name: SuperButterBuns
note: Long-form retrospectives, often on games nobody else revisits.

name: Nemesis Lacroix
note: Retro, indie and horror, plus live reactions to industry showcases.

name: Nikatine
note: Founder of Transmission Gaming. Roleplay, variety and community organising.

name: ZombieCleo
note: Minecraft building and variety, a long-running fixture of the scene.

name: SnapCube
note: Fandubs and comedic playthroughs. Not a review channel, and all the better for it.

name: ContraPoints
note: Essays on culture and gender rather than games, for when a game raises bigger questions.

name: Philosophy Tube
note: Theatrical philosophy essays that occasionally take games seriously as texts.

name: Mia Mulder
note: Video essays on politics, media and the systems underneath both.

name: Gooseworx
note: Animation and music rather than playthroughs, for the art-forward end of the catalogue.
